title: Can a talk leak data?
question: When we show real software to a room, what stops a private name, figure or key from reaching a screen or a shipped file?
how: A made-up company on stage, a sealed build as the only way out, and a leak scan that fails the build. Its tests run, and a fresh scan of the sealed build.
